queries.query: LLM OR "large language model" AND ("network configuration" OR NetOps OR "network operations") AND (generate OR synthesis OR "intent to config" OR "intent-to-configuration")
queries.rationale: Core phenomenon: LLM-driven generation of operational network configurations and intent-to-configuration translation.

queries.query: "configuration repair" OR "config repair" AND (LLM OR "large language model" OR "generative model") AND (validation OR verification OR "self-correction")
queries.rationale: Mechanisms and workflows for repair/iterative correction of LLM-produced network configs; generator–validator–repair architectures.

queries.query: "verifier-assisted" OR "tool-assisted" OR "program-aided" generation AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (network OR NetOps OR "network config")
queries.rationale: Tool-augmented LLM workflows (external validators, model-in-the-loop verifiers) for operational correctness.
source_preferences: preprints and engineering blogs documenting tool integrations

queries.query: safety OR "guarded generation" OR "constrained decoding" AND (LLM OR "large language model") AND (network OR "network configuration")
queries.rationale: Mitigation strategies for preventing unsafe or out-of-spec outputs (constrained decoding, guards, schemas) applied to NetOps.

queries.query: "formal verification" OR model checking OR "reachability analysis" AND ("network configuration" OR ACL OR routing OR "policy compliance")
queries.rationale: Deterministic validators and formal methods to assess whether a config meets connectivity/security/policy properties.

queries.query: network emulation simulator (mininet OR ns-3 OR GNS3 OR "network emulator") AND (evaluation OR validation OR "configuration testing")
queries.rationale: Execution environments for validating generated configs and measuring functional correctness in simulated topologies.

queries.query: benchmarks OR dataset OR "AIOps" OR "NetOps benchmark" AND (network OR "network configuration" OR "network intent")
queries.rationale: Assess existing benchmark validity and coverage for operational NetOps tasks and LLM evaluation.

queries.query: failure modes OR "misconfiguration" OR "outage" AND (LLM OR "language model" OR "generative AI") AND (network OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Empirical and incident-based descriptions of how generated configs can fail or cause outages/security issues.

queries.query: metrics OR evaluation OR "operational correctness" OR "policy compliance" OR reachability OR connectivity AND ("network configuration" OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Define and gather candidate quantitative metrics that map to operational trustworthiness and correctness.

queries.query: human-in-the-loop OR "operator" OR "network operator" AND (LLM OR "assistant") AND (trust OR explainability OR "decision support")
queries.rationale: Mitigations via human oversight, explainability, and operator interfaces for LLM-produced NetOps artifacts.

queries.query: adversarial OR "robustness" OR "adversarial testing" AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (network OR "configuration")
queries.rationale: Mechanisms for adversarially stressing generators and validators; security-centered robustness evaluations.

queries.query: "bounded self-correction" OR "iterative repair" OR "multi-step reasoning" AND (LLM OR agent OR "chain-of-thought") AND (NetOps OR network)
queries.rationale: Mechanistic patterns for iteration, bounded correction, and when/why iterative loops converge or diverge in NetOps tasks.
source_preferences: engineering blog posts describing agentic workflows

queries.query: LLM OR "program synthesis" applied to network automation OR "network scripting" OR "NetDevOps"
queries.rationale: Neighbouring work in program/code generation and automation for network management; lessons from code-generation evaluation and repair.

queries.query: datasets AND "network configurations" OR "network topologies" OR "routing tables" OR "firewall rules" AND (GitHub OR "data repository" OR "public dataset")
queries.rationale: Locate publicly available datasets and corpora suitable for evaluation, and inventory provenance/licensing.

inclusion_criteria: Primary sources (peer-reviewed papers, arXiv preprints, official tech reports) that directly treat LLMs/generative models applied to NetOps or configuration artifacts.
Works describing validators, formal verification, reachability, or emulation/testing methods for network configurations.
Benchmarks, datasets, and tooling releases with public access and clear provenance/licensing.
Operator-facing studies addressing trust, human-in-the-loop, or explainability in network automation.
Security/robustness/adversarial evaluations relevant to automated configuration generation.
exclusion_criteria: Papers only about general NLP benchmarks with no relation to network configurations, operations, or executable artifacts.
Non-English sources (unless a high-value, verifiable translation is available).
Opaque proprietary datasets or paywalled artifacts that cannot be accessed for verification.
Marketing blurbs and speculative opinion pieces without empirical or technical substance (vendor blogs may be used only for engineering details when corroborated).
Patent filings and legal texts unless directly cited for provenance; exclude as primary empirical evidence.
date_rationale: Cover recent rapid developments in generative AI (approx. 2018–2026) for model/agent architectures and tool integration, while allowing earlier foundational work (circa 2010 onward) for formal verification, network verification, and emulation methods. This balances currency (LLMs, agentic workflows) with classical verification and NetOps scholarship.
